packageRules.description: Automerge non-major + patch updates if CI passes
Major updates: open PR, no automerge — human review
Group Go module bumps so we don’t spam
Group Helm chart deps + values defaults
Group OpenTofu / Terraform deps under one PR
Pin Docker base images to digest — ADR-0015 supply-chain hygiene
golangci/golangci-lint is the binary version (with: version: vX.Y.Z) read by golangci-lint-action, not a Git ref. It cannot be digest-pinned; the action only accepts a release tag string.
kubernetes 1.x dependencies in go.mod — keep on minor channel

semantic-release plugins (release.yml extra_plugins): never automerge. The release job only runs on main, so no PR check exercises them; a floating conventionalcommits minor already broke one release.

The go.mod `go` directive is a deliberate security FLOOR (CVE fixes on OIDC/x509 paths), not a version to chase: raising it forces every consumer and tool (e.g. the Go that golangci-lint was built with) up with it. Toolchain bumps stay enabled.

customManagers.description: Resolve versions stored in OpenTofu/Terraform variable defaults or named locals that the native terraform manager can't follow. Annotate the assignment with a `# renovate:` comment on the line directly above it; the comment is the anchor, so any `<name> = "..."` line (a `default = ...` or a `local`-block assignment) is tracked.
semantic-release extra_plugins in release.yml are `name@version` lines no native manager sees. Exact-pinned since a floating minor broke the release (see the release.yml comment).
